gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-runic: Wide, bold, and quietly commanding. Goldman sets its letters far apart, while sans-serif Noto Sans Runic, with large lowercase and curves left unclosed, carries a long paragraph along smoothly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Commanding and wide-set, Goldman leads the way. Noto Sans Siddham, approachable and contemporary, gives its text a large central band and open-ended s shapes, so paragraphs keep moving without friction.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads crisp on screen, with wide, unclosed curves keeping each line open and followable. And Goldman takes the commanding, widely set heading while the body does the quiet work below.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Goldman is at its best making a wide, commanding statement. But sans-serif Noto Sans Tagalog is at its best as clean texture, its middle zone dominating the line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Widely set letters with generous clearance define Goldman. Goldman is made to command, while Noto Sans Tifinagh is made to invite, its rounded bowls filling the line like inflated shapes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Goldman sets wide letters with generous clearance and lowercase that looms large against the capitals. Noto Sans Ugaritic, sans-serif and approachable, shares that habit, its lowercase sitting almost level with the capitals, which ties the two together.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-gujarati: Ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut: that is Almendra Display. Anek Gujarati supplies a clean, approachable body whose lowercase rivals the capitals, so the ornate heading never has to compete.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-oxygen: Wide-set, bold, and hard to ignore. Oxygen, sans-serif and contemporary, keeps its curves open and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, so a long paragraph moves along without snagging.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-kannada: Grandstander draws bold, expressive lines of constant width, with short ascenders. But Anek Kannada, sans-serif, does its best work with terminals stopping far from the stem and an x-height that reaches high.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-odia: Thread stitched along a path: that is Grandstander, bold and expressive. Anek Odia matches that openness with unsealed rounds and capitals barely above the lowercase, which is the pair's biggest strength.
